_notes: Calibrated against measured self-noise (npm run calibrate: frame.avg <=3.4%, frame.p99 up to 14%). frame.avg is the tight stable anchor (5% rolling, safely above its ~3% noise). p99 gates sit above the 14% p99 self-noise so they only fire on gross tail regressions. A p99 FAIL should be confirmed with a re-run, since p99 has a wider run-to-run band.
